_comment: The plans page. PUBLIC-FULL for Agency and Digital Partner; PUBLIC-MASKED for Growth Partnership. The compare table's Growth Partnership column says 'Commercials explained after a business review' — Override 1 beats Architecture v3 §5, which had specified a wording that names the mechanism (SOURCE-OF-TRUTH §3 conflict 1). No Video 2 embed: Video 2 is gated, so the page routes to the gate instead. Cells beginning 'fact:' are looked up in commercial.json.
title: Plans — three ways to build the other half
meta_description: Agency, Digital Partner or Growth Partnership — three ways to build the side of a furniture business that brings the customers in.

sections.headline: Three ways to build the other half of your business.
sections.body: The difference between them is simple: how much of the work you keep doing yourself, and how much we take on.

sections.headline: How much of it do you want to keep doing yourself?
The same three plans, side by side.

rows._note: Chat 15: an 'Ad budget you pay' row sat further down carrying ₹50,000–₹2,00,000 for Agency and ₹1,00,000/month for Digital Partner. Both figures are withdrawn — Layer 4 v4 §6 says there is no fixed advertising budget and numbers.v2.js removed the DP one by name — and rewriting it to say who pays produced a second row saying exactly what this one already said. So the row is deleted rather than rewritten. This row was always the one that answered the question.

cells: You, straight to Google and Meta

sections.note: Ad money is always separate from the fee. On Agency and Digital Partner it stays in your own account and you pay Google and Meta yourself.

sections.headline: Not sure which one fits?
sections.body: Send us four numbers about your business. We will read them and tell you honestly which plan fits — and if none of them do, we will say that instead.

sections.headline: Still deciding?
sections.body: You do not have to pick one now. Send the four numbers and we will tell you where you stand.
